rows.role_title: National President of the Bharatiya Janata Party
rows.text: In the Hindi written answer to Unstarred Question 1067, headed 'भारतीय जनता पार्टी के अध्यक्ष द्वारा श्रीनगर में ध्वज फहराया जाना' (the flag hoisted at Srinagar by the President of the Bharatiya Janata Party), the Minister of State Shri M. M. Jacob says the Jammu and Kashmir Government reported that, because the road at Ramban was blocked, 'भारतीय जनता पार्टी के अध्यक्ष डा० मुरलीमनोहर जोशी' (the President of the Bharatiya Janata Party, Dr. Murli Manohar Joshi) had asked the State authorities to travel by air.
